## How it was checked

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] New behavior has a test, or there is a reason it doesn't need one
- [ ] New UI strings are in both `src/i18n/en.rs` and `src/i18n/ru.rs`
- [ ] User-visible change has a file in `changes/`
- [ ] Screenshots or a short video for visible changes
